title: Name resolution: Remove "ethers" and add personal "manuf" and "wka" files
description:
The functionality to map an MAC address to an IP address is odd
in the context of name resolution. IP addresses are not names.

It uses a system file (/etc/ethers), which I personally dislike,
because it has no separation of concerns. Maybe I don't want
to use my ethers file to resolve names in my network analyzer.

It is implemented in a fairly inneficient way that tries to read
one or more disk files for every new address it tries to resolve.

Replace this functionality with the wka file, that provides name
resolution to MAC addresses, supports arbitrary masks and is read
once at program startup.

Fixes #17416.

notes.body:
This is completely untested and probably has bugs.

I might rename the `wka` file back to `ethers` after.
